note: A direct conversion of the Scripps 1-minute global gravity-anomaly grid V33.1 around Chicxulub. Horizontal coordinates retain geographic metre scale. The vertical coordinate plots gravity anomaly at 500 display metres per mGal, relative to 0 mGal: it is not elevation, crater depth, geological relief or seismic topography. Colors also encode the recorded anomaly, with no radial template, ring, crater rim or inferred crater surface added. The 205 km authored aperture is geographic context for the approximately 180 km catalog diameter, not a measured crater boundary. Marine gravity and the EGM2008 land field have different information content; the landward crater signature is comparatively coarse. No crop walls, underside, stand, independent ruler or schematic geometry is included. Scripps Institution of Oceanography / UC San Diego, Sandwell et al.
